purpose: Prepare original owner-supplied moon references, not Studio evidence

pearl.initial: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: original Roblox moon disk texture for a Romantic Dark Fairytale sky. Input: the attached pearl moon concept is the edit target and the approved artistic reference. Preserve its lunar surface details, crater pattern and pearl-silver and restrained cool blue-gray maria, preserving the recognisable crater arrangement. Remove the entire surrounding painted glow/halo and all stray colored alpha fragments. Produce ONE clean circular full-moon disk centered in a 1024x1024 square, diameter about 900 pixels, with equal transparent margins. True transparent RGBA outside the disk, entirely transparent outer border, smooth accurately circular anti-aliased edge about 1-2 pixels, opaque textured moon interior. The disk must have no external glow, ring, corona, haze, stars, background, shadow, text or border. Do not redesign the surface, add objects or use any game franchise assets. This is a game texture cutout, not a scene or mockup.
pearl.cleanup: Precise alpha cleanup only. Edit the attached pearl moon texture. Keep all the existing interior lunar texture unchanged. REMOVE the jagged white/cyan/red fringe and all tiny protrusions along the perimeter. The final silhouette MUST be a perfectly smooth geometric circle, like a vector circle clipping mask, with 1-pixel antialiasing. Clip about 3% inward into the existing moon to remove the uneven edge. No rocky protrusions, no halo, no outline, no aura. Uniform transparent padding on all four sides, real RGBA transparent background. Single centered circular textured disk. Preserve the surface colors and crater details.
